en.s: Zhong Hui's Rebellion was a rebellion in March 264 led by Zhong Hui, a general of the state of Cao Wei, against the Wei regent, Sima Zhao. Zhong Hui had support from Jiang Wei, a general from the former state of Shu Han, which was conquered by Wei forces just before the rebellion started.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 钟会之乱是264年3月由曹魏将领钟会发动的一场叛乱，反抗魏国摄政司马昭。钟会得到蜀汉旧将姜维支持；魏军在叛乱爆发前不久刚刚灭亡蜀汉。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Empress Genshō abdicates the throne in favor of her nephew Shōmu who becomes emperor of Japan
en.s: Empress Genshō (元正天皇, Genshō-tennō; 680 – May 22, 748) was the 44th monarch of Japan, according to the traditional order of succession. Her reign spanned the years 715 through 724. Genshō was the fifth of eight women to take on the role of empress regnant, and the only one in the history of Japan to have inherited her title from another empress regnant rather than from a male predecessor.

zh.s: 724年3月3日，日本元正天皇退位，由侄子首皇子继位，成为圣武天皇。

en.t: Basil I signs the acts of the Council of Constantinople
en.s: On March 3, 880, Emperor Basil I signed the decrees of the Council of Constantinople of 879–880 at the imperial palace. The council confirmed Photios as patriarch of Constantinople, in present-day Istanbul, Turkey.
en.n: This records the emperor’s signing during the sixth session, rather than the start of the council.

zh.t: 巴西尔一世签署君士坦丁堡会议决议
zh.s: 880年3月3日，皇帝巴西尔一世在皇宫签署879至880年君士坦丁堡会议的决议。会议确认佛提乌担任君士坦丁堡牧首。君士坦丁堡即今天土耳其的伊斯坦布尔。
zh.n: 此条记录的是皇帝在第六次会议上签署决议，并非整个会议的开幕。

en.s: The Battle on the Nemiga River (Belarusian: Бітва на Нямізе; Russian: Битва на реке Немиге) was a battle of the Kievan Rus' feudal period that occurred on March 3, 1067 on the Niamiha River. The description of the battle is the first reference to Minsk in the chronicles of Belarusian history.

zh.s: 涅米加河战役（白俄罗斯语：Бітва на Нямізе；俄语：Битва на реке Немиге）是基辅罗斯封建时期的一场战役，发生于1067年3月3日，地点在涅米加河上。白俄罗斯历史编年史中关于这场战役的记载，是对明斯克最早的文字提及。

en.s: The Battle of Tukaroi, also known as the Battle of Bajhaura or the Battle of Mughulmari, was fought on March 3, 1575 near the village of Tukaroi now in Balasore District of Odisha situated between Midnapore and Jalesar, Odisha. This battle was between The Mughal Empire and the Sultanate of Bangala and Bihar.

zh.s: 1575年3月3日，莫卧儿帝国与孟加拉及比哈尔苏丹国，在图卡罗伊村附近交战。该地今属印度奥迪沙邦巴拉索尔县，位于米德纳普尔与奥迪沙的贾莱萨尔之间。此战也称巴贾乌拉战役或莫卧儿马里战役。

en.t: Teatro Olimpico opens with a performance of Oedipus Tyrannus
en.s: On March 3, 1585, Teatro Olimpico in Vicenza, in present-day Italy, was inaugurated with a performance of Sophocles’ Oedipus Tyrannus.

zh.t: 维琴察奥林匹克剧院以《俄狄浦斯王》演出揭幕
zh.s: 1585年3月3日，今意大利维琴察的奥林匹克剧院正式揭幕，首场演出是索福克勒斯的《俄狄浦斯王》。

en.t: Battle in the Bay of São Salvador
en.s: The Battle in the Bay of São Salvador took place on 3 March 1627 when Piet Pieterszoon Hein and his crew spotted about 34 enemy vessels at São Salvador. 16 of the ships were armed but Hein with his three vessels sailed right into the middle after a long battle the Dutch captured 22-25 of the ships with 2,700 chests of sugar, tobacco, and cotton.

zh.s: 1627年3月3日，皮特·彼得松·海因与船员在圣萨尔瓦多发现约34艘敌舰，圣萨尔瓦多湾海战由此爆发。敌舰中有16艘配备武器。经过长时间交战，海因率三艘船驶入敌舰队中央，荷兰人最终俘获22至25艘船，并缴获2,700箱糖、烟草和棉花。

en.s: The siege of Recife was a battle between Dutch and Portuguese forces near modern-day Recife, Brazil, in 1630. In the summer of 1629, the Dutch coveted a newfound interest in obtaining the captaincy of Pernambuco, the largest and richest sugar-producing area in the world. The Dutch fleet of 65 ships was led by Hendrick Corneliszoon Loncq.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1630年2月14日至3月3日，荷兰军队围攻葡萄牙控制的巴西累西腓，最终占领该城及附近的安东尼奥·瓦兹岛。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的围城结束日期。

loc: 瑞士阿尔高州莱茵费尔登

en.s: The Battle of Rheinfelden (28 February and 3 March 1638) was a military event in the course of the Thirty Years' War, consisting in fact of two battles to the north and south of the present-day town of Rheinfelden. On one side was a French-allied mercenary army led by Bernhard of Saxe-Weimar while the other side consisted of a joint Bavarian and Holy Roman Empire army and led by Johann von Werth and Federico Savelli. Bernhard was beaten in the first battle but managed to defeat and capture Werth and Savelli in the second.

zh.s: 莱茵费尔登战役是三十年战争中的两场交战，分别于1638年2月28日和3月3日在今莱茵费尔登镇南北两侧发生。一方是萨克森—魏玛的伯恩哈德率领、与法国结盟的雇佣军，另一方是约翰·冯·韦尔特与费德里科·萨韦利指挥的巴伐利亚—神圣罗马帝国联军。伯恩哈德首战失利，却在第二场获胜，并俘虏韦尔特和萨韦利。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Battle of Kaliabor, also known as Battle of Kaliabar, was a riverine naval battle fought between the Mughal Empire, under the command of its general Mir Jumla II, and the Ahom Kingdom, under the command of Bargohain. The battle was fought on March 3, 1662 near Kaliabor, on the Brahmaputra River situated in modern-day Assam state.

zh.s: 卡利阿博尔战役又称卡利巴尔战役，是一场河上水战，交战双方为莫卧儿帝国和阿洪姆王国。莫卧儿军由将领米尔·朱姆拉二世指挥，阿洪姆军由巴尔戈海因指挥。战斗于1662年3月3日在卡利阿博尔附近的布拉马普特拉河上进行，该地位于今印度阿萨姆邦。

en.t: The first Battle of Tobago is fought in Rockley Bay
en.s: On March 3, 1677, a French squadron commanded by Jean d’Estrées attacked the Dutch fleet under Jacob Binckes at Tobago. The first Battle of Tobago caused heavy losses on both sides; a second battle followed in December.
en.n: This entry records the first battle of Tobago; a second battle took place in December 1677.

zh.t: 托巴哥第一次海战在罗克利湾爆发
zh.s: 1677年3月3日，让·德斯特雷指挥的法国舰队在托巴哥袭击雅各布·宾克斯率领的荷兰舰队。第一次托巴哥海战造成双方重大损失；同年12月又发生了第二次海战。
zh.n: 此条记录的是托巴哥第一次海战；1677年12月还发生过第二次海战。

en.s: The bombardment of Arras was an engagement of the War of the Spanish Succession which took place on 2–3 March 1712. A Grand Alliance army under the command of Arnold van Keppel, 1st Earl of Albemarle closed in on Arras with the aim of destroying the supplies held there. The Allies intended for this to prevent the French from fending off sieges of Arras and Cambrai.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 阿拉斯炮击是西班牙王位继承战争期间的一场交战，发生于1712年3月2日至3日。阿尔伯马尔伯爵阿诺德·范·凯佩尔率领大同盟军逼近阿拉斯，企图摧毁当地的补给。盟军希望以此阻止法军抵挡对阿拉斯和康布雷的围攻。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The raid of Nassau on March 3–4, 1776, was a naval operation and amphibious assault by American forces against the British port of Nassau, Bahamas, during the American Revolutionary War. The raid, designed to resolve the issue of gunpowder shortages, resulted in the seizure of two forts and large quantities of military supplies before the raiders drew back to New England.

zh.s: 1776年3月3日至4日，美国军队在美国独立战争期间对巴哈马英国港口拿骚实施海上行动和两栖突袭。行动旨在解决火药短缺问题，美军夺取了两座堡垒和大量军需物资，随后撤回新英格兰。

en.s: The Battle of Brier Creek was an American Revolutionary War battle fought on March 3, 1779, near the confluence of Brier Creek with the Savannah River in eastern Georgia. An American Patriot force consisting principally of militia from North Carolina and Georgia along with some Continental Army troops were defeated by British forces, suffering significant casualties. The rout damaged Patriot morale.

zh.s: 布里尔溪战役是美国独立战争期间的一场战斗，于1779年3月3日在佐治亚东部布里尔溪与萨凡纳河汇流处附近进行。以北卡罗来纳和佐治亚民兵为主、另有部分大陆军士兵组成的爱国者部队被英军击败，伤亡惨重。这场溃败打击了爱国者的士气。

en.s: The Battle of West Kay (Danish: Slaget ved Fugleklippen), also known as the Battle of Fugleklippen, was a naval battle between Denmark–Norway and the United Kingdom. It took place at the Skerry of West Kay (Danish: Fugleklippen), near Saint Thomas and ended in a Danish victory.

zh.s: 西凯岛海战又称“福格勒克利彭海战”，是丹麦—挪威与英国之间的一场海战。战斗发生在圣托马斯岛附近的西凯礁（丹麦语：Fugleklippen），最终丹麦—挪威获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Laubressel (3 March 1814) saw the main Allied army of Field Marshal Karl Philipp, Prince of Schwarzenberg mount a three-pronged converging attack on the weaker army of Marshal Jacques MacDonald. The French forces under Marshal Nicolas Oudinot bore the brunt of the fighting, in which the Allies tried to turn their left flank. The French abandoned Troyes and retreated west as a result of the action. The village of Laubressel is located 10 kilometres (6 mi) east of Troyes. After the French victory at the Battle of Montereau on 18 February, Schwarzenberg's army withdrew behind the Aube River.

zh.s: 1814年3月3日，卡尔·菲利普·施瓦岑贝格亲王元帅率反法同盟主力军，分三路合击雅克·麦克唐纳元帅较弱的部队。尼古拉·乌迪诺元帅率领的法军承担主要战斗，盟军试图迂回其左翼。战后，法军放弃特鲁瓦向西撤退。洛布雷塞勒村位于特鲁瓦以东10公里，约6英里。此前2月18日法军在蒙特罗战役获胜后，施瓦岑贝格的军队已撤到奥布河后方。

en.s: The Capture of Talca, occurred on 3 March 1814, during the War of Chilean Independence.

zh.s: 1814年3月3日，智利独立战争期间，爱国者军队攻占塔尔卡。

en.s: The Battle of Pelee Island took place during the Patriot War along what is now the Ohio-Ontario nautical border in 1838 involving small groups of men on each side of the border seeking to overthrow British rule in Upper Canada.

zh.s: 皮利岛战役发生于1838年爱国者战争期间，地点在今俄亥俄州与安大略省之间的水域边界一带。边界两侧都有小股武装人员参战，目的是推翻上加拿大的英国统治。

en.s: The 1840 Chicago mayoral election saw Democratic nominee Alexander Loyd defeat incumbent Whig Benjamin Wright Raymond by a landslide 15.8 point margin. With a narrative that local elections such as Chicago's would be a bellwether of the coming 1840 United States presidential election, both parties locally viewed the election as being of great importance. Chicago's mayoral result, ultimately, was no bellwether of the presidential election's party outcome.

zh.s: 1840年芝加哥市长选举中，民主党候选人亚历山大·洛伊德以大幅优势击败现任辉格党市长本杰明·赖特·雷蒙德。当地两党都认为这次选举非常重要，视其为即将举行的1840年美国总统选举的风向标。不过，芝加哥市长选举结果最终并未预示总统选举的党派胜负。

en.s: The Kraków Uprising (Polish: powstanie krakowskie, rewolucja krakowska; German: Krakauer Aufstand; Russian: краковское восстание, romanized: krakovskoye vosstaniye) of 1846 was an attempt, led by Polish insurgents such as Jan Tyssowski and Edward Dembowski, to incite a fight for national independence. The uprising was centered on the city of Kraków, the capital of the small Free City of Cracow.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1846年的克拉科夫起义（波兰语：powstanie krakowskie、rewolucja krakowska；德语：Krakauer Aufstand；俄语：краковское восстание，罗马字：krakovskoye vosstaniye）是波兰起义者试图争取民族独立的一场行动，领导者包括扬·蒂索夫斯基和爱德华·登博夫斯基。起义以克拉科夫为中心，当时该城是自由城克拉科夫的首府。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: In the 1857 Chicago mayoral election, Republican nominee John Wentworth defeated Democratic nominee Benjamin Carver by a ten-point margin. The election was held on March 3.

zh.s: 1857年3月3日举行的芝加哥市长选举中，共和党候选人约翰·温特沃思以10个百分点的优势击败民主党候选人本杰明·卡弗。

en.s: In the Chicago mayoral election of 1860, Democratic nominee John Wentworth defeated Republican nominee Walter S. Gurnee. Both candidates had served as mayor before. Incidentally, each had previously been mayor under the opposite party affiliation. Gurnee had served two terms as a Democrat, having been elected in 1851 and 1852, Wentworth had previously served one term as a Republican, having been elected in 1857.

zh.s: 1860年芝加哥市长选举中，民主党候选人约翰·温特沃思击败共和党候选人沃尔特·S·格尼。两人此前都当过市长，而且都曾以不同党派身份任职：格尼曾于1851年和1852年以民主党人身份担任两届市长；温特沃思则于1857年以共和党人身份担任过一届市长。

en.t: Alexander II issues the Emancipation Manifesto
en.s: On March 3, 1861 (February 19 in the Julian calendar), Alexander II issued the Emancipation Manifesto in Russia. It granted freedom to serfs on privately owned estates and to household serfs, while setting conditions for peasants to buy land.
en.n: The date is March 3 in the Gregorian calendar and February 19 in the Julian calendar then used in Russia.

zh.t: 亚历山大二世颁布废除农奴制宣言
zh.s: 1861年3月3日（俄国当时使用的儒略历2月19日），亚历山大二世颁布废除农奴制宣言。宣言赋予私人庄园农奴和家内农奴自由，并规定了农民购买土地的条件。
zh.n: 公历日期为3月3日；俄国当时使用的儒略历日期为2月19日。

en.s: The First Battle of Fort McAllister was a series of naval attacks that took place from January 27 to March 3, 1863, at Fort McAllister in Bryan County, Georgia, during the American Civil War. The commander of the South Atlantic Blockading Squadron Rear Adm. Samuel F. Du Pont decided to test operation of new monitors against Fort McAllister before conducting a major naval operation against Charleston, South Carolina.
en.n: The First Battle of Fort McAllister was a series of naval attacks that took place from January 27 to March 3, 1863, at Fort McAllister in Bryan County, Georgia, during the American Civil War.

zh.t: 麦卡利斯特堡第一次战役
zh.s: 麦卡利斯特堡第一次战役是美国内战期间一系列海上攻击，发生于1863年1月27日至3月3日，地点在佐治亚州布莱恩县的麦卡利斯特堡。南大西洋封锁分舰队司令塞缪尔·F·杜庞特海军少将决定先测试新型浅水重炮舰对堡垒的作战效果，再对南卡罗来纳州查尔斯顿发动大规模海战。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The first Federal elections were held in Germany on 3 March 1871. The National Liberal Party emerged as the largest party in the Reichstag, with 125 of the 382 seats. Voter turnout was just 52.0%.

zh.s: 德国于1871年3月3日首次举行联邦选举。民族自由党在国会382席中赢得125席，成为第一大党。投票率仅52.0%。

en.s: The Comstock Act of 1873 is a series of provisions in federal law, currently still in effect and enforced, that generally criminalize the conveying of obscene matter through the post office or common carriers. It also covers crime-inciting matter, or certain abortion-related matter. The Comstock Act is largely codified across title 18 of the United States Code and was enacted beginning in 1872 with the attachment of a rider to the Post Office Consolidation Act of 1872.
en.n: This entry records the signing, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1873年康斯托克法案由一系列目前仍有效并在执行的联邦法律条文组成，主要将通过邮局或公共运输公司寄送淫秽物品定为犯罪，也涵盖煽动犯罪的内容和部分与堕胎有关的物品。该法案的大部分内容编入《美国法典》第18编。相关条文于1872年起陆续通过，最初作为附加条款纳入《1872年邮政整合法案》。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框标注的签署日期。

en.s: The Liberation of Bulgaria is the historical process as a result of the Bulgarian Revival. In Bulgarian historiography, the liberation of Bulgaria refers to those events of the Tenth Russo-Turkish War (1877–1878) that led to the re-establishment of the Bulgarian state under the Treaty of San Stefano of 3 March 1878. Today Bulgaria observes its National Liberation Day on 3 March.

zh.s: “保加利亚解放”指保加利亚民族复兴运动推动的历史进程。在保加利亚史学中，这一说法特指第十次俄土战争（1877—1878年）期间促成保加利亚国家重建的事件，最终结果是签订1878年3月3日《圣斯特凡诺条约》。今天，保加利亚仍在3月3日庆祝国家解放日。

en.t: Russia and the Ottoman Empire sign the Treaty of San Stefano
en.s: On 3 March 1878 (19 February Old Style), Russia and the Ottoman Empire signed the Treaty of San Stefano at San Stefano, now Yeşilköy in Istanbul, Türkiye, ending the Russo-Turkish War of 1877–1878.
en.n: The signing date is 3 March 1878 in the Gregorian calendar; the treaty gives the date as 19 February Old Style (3 March).

zh.t: 俄罗斯帝国与奥斯曼帝国签署《圣斯特凡诺条约》
zh.s: 1878年3月3日（旧历2月19日），俄罗斯帝国与奥斯曼帝国在圣斯特凡诺签署条约，结束1877至1878年的俄土战争。圣斯特凡诺今为土耳其伊斯坦布尔的耶希尔柯伊。
zh.n: 条约签署日期按公历为1878年3月3日；条约原文同时注明旧历2月19日。

en.s: The siege of Tuyên Quang was an important confrontation between the French and the Chinese armies in Tonkin (northern Vietnam) during the Sino-French War (August 1884 – April 1885). A French garrison of 619 men, including two companies of the French Foreign Legion, successfully defended the French post of Tuyên Quang against vastly outnumbering Chinese forces in a four-month siege from 24 November 1884 to 3 March 1885.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 宣光围城战是中法战争（1884年8月至1885年4月）期间，法国军队与清军在东京（今越南北部）的一场重要交战。由619人组成的法军守军，包括两连法国外籍军团士兵，在1884年11月24日至1885年3月3日长达四个月的围城中，成功守住宣光法军据点。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: General elections were held in Malta between 1 and 3 March 1888.

zh.s: 马耳他于1888年3月1日至3日举行大选。

en.t: Shoshone National Forest is established as the first national forest in the US and world
en.s: Shoshone National Forest ( shoh-SHOH-nee) is the first federally protected National Forest in the United States and covers nearly 2,500,000 acres (10,000 km2) in the state of Wyoming. Originally a part of the Yellowstone Timberland Reserve, the forest is managed by the United States Forest Service and was created by an act of Congress and signed into law by U.S. President Benjamin Harrison in 1891.

zh.t: 肖松尼国家森林建立，成为美国和世界首个国家森林
zh.s: 肖松尼国家森林位于美国怀俄明州，面积近250万英亩（10,000平方公里），是美国首个受联邦保护的国家森林。它最初属于黄石木材保护区，现由美国国家森林局管理。1891年，国会通过法案设立该森林，并由本杰明·哈里森总统签署生效。

en.s: An election to the County Council of London took place on 3 March 1898. The council was elected by First Past the Post with each elector having two votes in the two-member seats. The Progressive Party won a substantial majority on the council.

zh.s: 1898年3月3日，伦敦郡议会举行选举，采用得票最多者当选的制度，双议席选区每名选民可投两票。进步党取得议会明显多数。

en.s: The Battle of Derna, also known as the Battle of Sidi Abdullah (Arabic: معركة سيدي عبد الله), occurred near Derna in 3 March 1912, within the scope of Italo-Turkish War. The battle took place between the Italians led by Luigi Capello and Ottoman-Senussi Forces led by Enver Pasha and Ahmed Sharif as-Senussi.

zh.s: 1912年3月3日，意土战争期间，路易吉·卡佩洛率意军，与恩维尔帕夏及艾哈迈德·谢里夫·塞努西率领的奥斯曼—塞努西联军，在代尔纳附近交战。此战也称西迪阿卜杜拉战役。

en.s: The Battle of Hiraan was fought on March 3, 1913 in Beledweyne between the Italian Somaliland and the Dervish movement. The Italians never attacked again leaving the Dervish to rule over the south freely.

zh.s: 1913年3月3日，意属索马里部队与德尔维希运动在贝莱德文交战，史称希兰战役。意方此后没有再次进攻，让德尔维希得以自由统治南部。

en.s: The Treaty of Brest-Litovsk was a separate peace treaty signed on 3 March 1918 between Russia and the Central Powers (Germany, Austria-Hungary, the Ottoman Empire, and Bulgaria), by which Russia withdrew from World War I. The treaty, which followed months of negotiations after the armistice on the Eastern Front in December 1917, was signed at Brest-Litovsk (now Brest, Belarus).

zh.t: 布列斯特-立托夫斯克条约
zh.s: 《布列斯特-立托夫斯克条约》是俄罗斯与同盟国（德国、奥匈帝国、奥斯曼帝国和保加利亚）于1918年3月3日签署的单独媾和条约。根据条约，俄罗斯退出第一次世界大战。1917年12月东线停战后，双方经过数月谈判，最终在布列斯特-立托夫斯克（今白俄罗斯布列斯特）签署条约。

en.s: The Operation Faustschlag or Unternehmen Faustschlag (lit. 'Operation Fist Punch'), also known as the Eleven Days' War, was a Central Powers offensive in World War I. It was the last major offensive on the Eastern Front. Russian forces were unable to put up any serious resistance due to the turmoil of the Russian Revolution and subsequent Russian Civil War.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 拳击行动（德语：Unternehmen Faustschlag，意为“拳击行动”）又称“十一日战争”，是第一次世界大战期间同盟国发起的一次攻势，也是东线最后一次大规模攻势。俄罗斯革命及随后的俄国内战造成局势混乱，俄军无法组织有效抵抗。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Finland between 1 and 3 March 1919. The Social Democratic Party emerged as the largest in Parliament with 80 of the 200 seats. Voter turnout was 67.1%.

zh.s: 芬兰于1919年3月1日至3日举行议会选举。社会民主党在200席中赢得80席，成为第一大党。投票率为67.1%。

en.s: The Dudley by-election of 1921 was held on 3 March 1921. The by-election was held due to the appointment of the incumbent Coalition Conservative MP, Arthur Griffith-Boscawen, as Minister of Agriculture. It was won by the Labour candidate James Wilson. It was one of only eight ministerial by-elections in the UK to not be retained by the incumbent.

zh.s: 1921年3月3日，英国达德利选区举行补选，原因是联合政府保守党议员阿瑟·格里菲斯-博斯科恩获任农业部长。工党候选人詹姆斯·威尔逊当选。这是英国仅有的八场原议员未能保住议席的部长补选之一。

en.s: General elections were held in Romania between 1 and 3 March 1922. In the first stage between 1 and 3 March, seats in the Senate were elected. In the second stage between 5 and 7 March the Chamber of Deputies was elected, and in the third and final stage from 9 to 11 March, additional Senate seats were elected. The result was a victory for the National Liberal Party, which won 222 of the 372 seats in the Chamber of Deputies and 111 of the 148 seats in the Senate. Both houses were combined to form a Constitutional Assembly, which passed the 1923 constitution.

zh.s: 罗马尼亚1922年大选分阶段进行：3月1日至3日先选举参议院部分议席，3月5日至7日选举众议院，3月9日至11日再选举其余参议院议席。国家自由党在众议院372席中赢得222席、参议院148席中赢得111席，取得胜利。两院合组成制宪议会，通过了1923年宪法。

en.s: The Mitcham by-election of 1923 was held on 3 March 1923. The by-election was held due to the resignation of the incumbent Conservative MP, Richard James Meller. It was won by the Labour candidate James Chuter Ede.

zh.s: 1923年3月3日，英国米彻姆选区举行补选，填补保守党议员理查德·詹姆斯·梅勒辞职留下的空缺。工党候选人詹姆斯·丘特·伊德当选。

en.s: The Willesden East by-election, 1923 was a parliamentary by-election for the British House of Commons constituency of Willesden East held on 3 March 1923. The constituency was a large one extending from Kilburn in the south to the Welsh Harp and on to Neasden.

zh.s: 1923年3月3日，英国下议院威尔斯登东选区举行议会补选。该选区范围很大，从南面的基尔本延伸至威尔士竖琴水库，再到尼斯登。

en.t: US magazine Time publishes its first issue
en.s: Time is an American news magazine based in New York City. It was published weekly for nearly a century. Starting in March 2020, it was published every other week. It was first published in New York City on March 3, 1923, and for many years it was run by its co-founder, Henry Luce. A European edition, Time Europe, is published in London and also covers the Middle East, Africa, and Latin America.

zh.s: 《时代》是一份总部位于纽约的美国新闻杂志，近一个世纪以来一直每周发行。自2020年3月起改为每两周发行一期。杂志于1923年3月3日在纽约首次出版，多年来由联合创始人亨利·卢斯主持。欧洲版《时代》在伦敦出版，也报道中东、非洲和拉丁美洲。

en.s: On March 3, 1924, the Grand National Assembly of Turkey abolished the Ottoman caliphate. Abdülmecid II was deposed as the last Ottoman caliph.

zh.t: 土耳其大国民议会废除奥斯曼哈里发制度
zh.s: 1924年3月3日，土耳其大国民议会废除奥斯曼哈里发制度，阿卜杜勒-迈吉德二世失去哈里发职位，成为最后一位奥斯曼哈里发。

en.t: Oil is discovered in Saudi Arabia
en.s: Petroleum, also known as crude oil or simply oil, is a natural resource that appears as a yellowish-black liquid chemical mixture found in geological formations, consisting primarily of hydrocarbons. The term petroleum refers to both naturally occurring unprocessed crude oil, as well as to petroleum products that consist of refined crude oil. Petroleum is a fossil fuel formed over millions of years from anaerobic decay of organic materials from buried prehistoric organisms, particularly plankton and algae.

zh.s: 石油也称原油，是一种黄色至黑色的液态天然资源，主要由烃类组成，存在于地质构造中。“石油”既指天然存在、未经加工的原油，也指由原油精炼而成的产品。石油是一种化石燃料，由埋藏的史前生物（尤其是浮游生物和藻类）遗骸在缺氧环境中经过数百万年分解形成。

loc: 澳大利亚西澳州布鲁姆

en.s: The town of Broome, Western Australia was attacked by Japanese fighter planes on 3 March 1942, during World War II. At least 88 people were killed. Although Broome was a small pearling port at the time, it was also a refuelling point for aircraft, on the route between the Netherlands East Indies and major Australian cities. As a result, Broome was on a line of flight for Dutch and other refugees, following the Japanese invasion of Java, and had become a significant Allied military base.

zh.s: 1942年3月3日，第二次世界大战期间，日本战斗机袭击西澳大利亚布鲁姆镇，造成至少88人死亡。布鲁姆虽只是一个小型采珠港，却也是荷属东印度与澳大利亚主要城市之间航线的加油点。日军入侵爪哇后，荷兰人及其他难民经此撤离，使布鲁姆成为重要的盟军军事基地。

en.s: The Battle of Kalijati occurred between 1 and 3 March 1942 during the Dutch East Indies campaign between invading Japanese forces and the Dutch colonial forces. It was fought over control of the Kalijati Airfield in Subang. Following their unexpected landing, Japanese forces commanded by Toshinari Shōji moved rapidly and seized the airfield on the same day it landed before the Dutch command could deploy reinforcements.

zh.s: 卡利查蒂战役发生于1942年3月1日至3日，是荷属东印度群岛战役的一部分，交战双方为入侵的日军和荷兰殖民军。双方争夺苏邦的卡利查蒂机场。日军出乎荷军意料地登陆后，在东俊成指挥下迅速行动，同一天就夺取了机场，荷军指挥部还来不及部署增援。

en.s: Operation Star or Operation Zvezda (Russian: Звезда, lit. 'Star') was a Red Army offensive on the Eastern Front of World War II begun on 2 February 1943. The attack was the responsibility of the Voronezh Front under the command of Filipp Golikov and a part of the larger Voronezh-Kharkov Strategic Offensive Operation. Its main objectives were the cities of Kharkov and Kursk.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: “星”行动（俄语：Звезда，意为“星”）是苏联红军在第二次世界大战东线发起的一次攻势，始于1943年2月2日。行动由菲利普·戈利科夫指挥的沃罗涅日方面军负责，是更大规模的沃罗涅日—哈尔科夫战略攻势的一部分，主要目标是哈尔科夫和库尔斯克两座城市。

en.s: The Voronezh–Kharkov strategic offensive operation was a successful strategic offensive operation of the Red Army's Voronezh, Bryansk and South-Western fronts, carried out from January 13 to March 3, 1943 with the aim of defeating the German Army Group B and liberating a large territory and the important industrial and administrative centers Voronezh, Kursk, Belgorod and Kharkov.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 沃罗涅日—哈尔科夫攻势
zh.s: 沃罗涅日—哈尔科夫战略攻势是红军沃罗涅日方面军、布良斯克方面军和西南方面军发起的一次成功战略攻势，持续时间为1943年1月13日至3月3日。行动旨在击败德国B集团军群，解放大片领土以及沃罗涅日、库尔斯克、别尔哥罗德和哈尔科夫等重要工业和行政中心。

en.s: The Balvano train disaster occurred on the night between 2–3 March 1944 in Balvano, Basilicata, when 517 people in a steam-hauled, coal-burning freight train (mostly stowaways) died of carbon monoxide poisoning during a protracted stall in a tunnel. It was the deadliest railway accident in Italian history and one of the worst railway disasters ever.

zh.s: 1944年3月2日至3日夜间，意大利巴西利卡塔大区巴尔瓦诺发生列车事故。一列由蒸汽机车牵引、以煤为燃料的货运列车在隧道内长时间停滞，车上517人（多数为偷乘者）死于一氧化碳中毒。这是意大利历史上死亡人数最多的铁路事故，也是全球最严重的铁路灾难之一。

en.s: The bombing of the Bezuidenhout took place on 3 March 1945, when the Royal Air Force accidentally bombed the Bezuidenhout neighbourhood in the Dutch city of The Hague. At the time, the neighbourhood was more densely populated than usual with evacuees from The Hague and Wassenaar; tens of thousands were left homeless and had to be quartered in the Eastern and Central Netherlands. The British bomber crews had intended to bomb the Haagse Bos ("Forest of the Hague") district where the Germans had installed V-2 launching facilities that had been used to attack English cities.

zh.s: 1945年3月3日，英国皇家空军误炸荷兰海牙的贝泽登豪特社区。当时这里安置了来自海牙及瓦瑟纳尔的疏散居民，比平日更加拥挤。轰炸使数万人无家可归，不得不安置到荷兰东部和中部。英军轰炸机原本的目标是海牙森林地区，德军在那里设置V-2导弹发射设施，攻击英国城市。

en.s: Operation Blockbuster was the completion of the larger Operation Veritable by the First Canadian Army, reinforced by the XXX Corps from the British Second Army from late February to early March, 1945. Veritable had been slower and more costly than expected and the Canadian commander, General Harry Crerar, had decided on a fresh start for the operation.

zh.s: 封锁行动是加拿大第一集团军完成更大规模的“真实行动”的最后阶段。1945年2月底至3月初，英国第二集团军第30军增援加拿大部队。此前“真实行动”推进速度比预期慢，代价也更大，加拿大司令哈里·克雷拉尔将军因此决定重新启动行动。

en.s: The defense of the Schwedt bridgehead was a German 3rd Panzer Army operation on the Eastern Front during the final months of World War II. German forces, commanded by Otto Skorzeny, were ordered to prepare to conduct a counter-offensive. However they were forced to hold a bridgehead against expected numerically superior forces of the Soviet 2nd Belorussian Front (Marshal Konstantin Rokossovsky) for 31 days.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 施韦特桥头堡防御战是第二次世界大战末期，德国第三装甲集团军在东线执行的一项行动。奥托·斯科尔兹内指挥的德军奉命准备发动反攻，但随后不得不坚守桥头堡，以抵挡苏联康斯坦丁·罗科索夫斯基元帅指挥的第二白俄罗斯方面军。德军在此坚守了31天。

en.s: The 3 March affair (Indonesian: Peristiwa Tiga Maret) was an attempted coup against the Indonesian republican administration in West Sumatra during the Indonesian National Revolution by Islamic militias. The coup failed and its leaders were arrested.

zh.s: 三月三日事件（印度尼西亚语：Peristiwa Tiga Maret）是印度尼西亚民族革命期间，伊斯兰民兵试图在西苏门答腊发动政变、推翻共和政府的事件。政变失败，领导人被捕。

en.s: State elections were held in South Australia on 3 March 1956. All 39 seats in the South Australian House of Assembly were up for election. The incumbent Liberal and Country League led by Premier of South Australia Thomas Playford IV defeated the Australian Labor Party led by Leader of the Opposition Mick O'Halloran. A redistribution occurred in 1955 based upon the results of the census held in June 1954.

zh.s: 1956年3月3日，南澳大利亚州举行选举，改选州众议院全部39个席位。时任州长托马斯·普莱福德四世领导的自由与乡村联盟击败了由反对党领袖米克·奥哈洛伦领导的澳大利亚工党。

en.s: The 1956 New South Wales state election was held on 3 March 1956. It was conducted in single member constituencies with compulsory preferential voting and was held on boundaries created at a 1952 redistribution. The election was for all of the 94 seats in the Legislative Assembly.

zh.s: 1956年3月3日，新南威尔士州举行州选举。选举采用单一选区制和强制性排序投票，选区边界依据1952年选区调整结果划定。选举改选立法议会全部94个席位。

en.t: Nuri al-Said begins another term as Iraq’s prime minister
en.s: On March 3, 1958, Nuri al-Said began another term as prime minister of Iraq under King Faisal II, succeeding Abdul-Wahab Mirjan.
en.n: This is the beginning of this term as prime minister of Iraq, rather than his later role in the Arab Federation.

zh.t: 努里·赛义德再次出任伊拉克首相
zh.s: 1958年3月3日，努里·赛义德在费萨尔二世统治下再次出任伊拉克首相，接替阿卜杜勒·瓦哈卜·米尔詹。
zh.n: 此处记录这届伊拉克首相任期的开始，并非他后来担任阿拉伯联邦首相的日期。

en.s: The 1959 Urban Council Election was held on 3 March 1959 for the 4 of the 8 elected seats of the Urban Council of Hong Kong. The turnout rate dropped to 30.5% but there were still 7,236 voters cast their votes, 5,354 ballots from Hong Kong Island and 1,882 from Kowloon.

zh.s: 1959年3月3日，香港市政局举行选举，改选8个民选议席中的4席。投票率降至30.5%，仍有7236人投票，其中香港岛5354票，九龙1882票。

en.s: The 1959 Missouri's 4th congressional district special election was held on March 3, 1959, and was won by Jackson County Judge William J. Randall, the Democratic nominee. On January 23, 1959, Democratic Congressman George H. Christopher died, causing a vacancy. On February 2, Governor James Blair issued a proclamation for the special election, which he deliberately scheduled with the Kansas City municipal election primary.

zh.t: 1959年密苏里州第四国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 1959年3月3日，密苏里州第四国会选区举行特别选举，民主党候选人、杰克逊县法官威廉·J.兰德尔当选。原任民主党众议员乔治·H.克里斯托弗于1月23日去世，留下空缺。州长詹姆斯·布莱尔于2月2日发布选举公告，有意把日期安排在堪萨斯城市政选举初选当天。

en.s: State elections were held in South Australia on 3 March 1962. All 39 seats in the South Australian House of Assembly were up for election. The incumbent Liberal and Country League led by Premier of South Australia Thomas Playford IV defeated the Australian Labor Party led by Leader of the Opposition Frank Walsh. This was the first and only time that a South Australian Government won a tenth consecutive term in office.

zh.s: 1962年3月3日，南澳大利亚州举行选举，改选州众议院全部39个席位。时任州长托马斯·普莱福德四世领导的自由与乡村联盟击败了由反对党领袖弗兰克·沃尔什领导的澳大利亚工党。这是南澳政府首次、也是唯一一次连续十届胜选。

en.s: The 1962 New South Wales state election was held on 3 March 1962. It was conducted in single member constituencies with compulsory preferential voting and was held on boundaries created at a 1961 redistribution. The election was for all of the 94 seats in the Legislative Assembly.

zh.s: 1962年3月3日，新南威尔士州举行州选举。选举采用单一选区制和强制性排序投票，选区边界依据1961年选区调整结果划定。选举改选立法议会全部94个席位。

en.s: The New Orleans mayoral election of 1962 resulted in the election of interim mayor Victor Schiro to his first full term as mayor of New Orleans.

zh.s: 1962年新奥尔良市长选举由临时市长维克多·席罗获胜，他因此当选新奥尔良市长的首个完整任期。

en.s: The 1964 Louisiana gubernatorial election was held in the U.S. state on March 3, 1964. Democrat John McKeithen won a highly-competitive primary and dispatched Republican Charlton Lyons in the general election, though Lyons made a historically good showing for a Louisiana Republican up to this point. The two Democratic Party primaries were held on December 7, 1963, and January 11.

zh.s: 美国路易斯安那州于1964年3月3日举行州长选举。民主党人约翰·麦基森赢得竞争激烈的党内初选后，在正式选举中击败共和党的查尔顿·莱昂斯。不过，莱昂斯的表现已是当时路易斯安那共和党候选人历史上较好的一次。两轮民主党初选分别于1963年12月7日及1964年1月11日举行。

en.s: The 1964 Louisiana lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on March 3, 1964, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Louisiana. Democratic nominee and incumbent lieutenant governor Taddy Aycock won re-election as he ran unopposed.

zh.t: 1964年路易斯安那州副州长选举
zh.s: 路易斯安那州于1964年3月3日举行副州长选举。民主党候选人、现任副州长塔迪·艾科克没有对手，成功连任。

en.s: Apollo 9 was the third manned mission in the United States Apollo space program and the first flight of the Command/Service Module (CSM) with the Lunar Module (LM). Its three-person crew, consisting of Commander James McDivitt, Command Module Pilot David Scott, and Lunar Module Pilot Rusty Schweickart, spent ten days in low Earth orbit testing several aspects critical to landing on the Moon, including the LM engines, backpack life support systems, navigation systems, and docking maneuvers. The mission was the second manned launch of a Saturn V rocket.

zh.s: 阿波罗9号是美国阿波罗计划的第三次载人任务，也是指令与服务舱首次携带登月舱飞行。指令长詹姆斯·麦克迪维特、指令舱驾驶员戴维·斯科特及登月舱驾驶员拉斯蒂·施威卡特，三人在近地轨道停留十天，测试登月关键技术，包括登月舱发动机、背包式生命维持系统、导航系统及对接操作。这也是土星五号火箭第二次载人发射。

en.s: Little Maracanazo was a football match played between Fluminense FC of Brazil and Deportivo Italia of Venezuela in the group stage of the 1971 Copa Libertadores. Fluminense, managed by Mário Zagallo who had just won the 1970 World Cup, were defeated 1–0.

zh.s: “小马拉卡纳惨案”是1971年南美解放者杯小组赛的一场足球比赛，由巴西弗鲁米嫩塞队对阵委内瑞拉意大利体育队。弗鲁米嫩塞队由刚刚赢得1970年世界杯的马里奥·扎加洛执教，最终以0比1告负。

en.s: Mohawk Airlines Flight 405, a Fairchild Hiller FH-227 twin-engine turboprop airliner registered N7818M, was a domestic scheduled passenger flight operated by Mohawk Airlines that crashed into a house within the city limits of Albany, New York, on March 3, 1972, on final approach to Albany County Airport (now Albany International Airport), New York, killing 17 people.

zh.s: 莫霍克航空405号班机是一架注册号为N7818M的费尔柴尔德·希勒FH-227双发涡桨客机，由莫霍克航空运营，执飞定期国内客运航班。1972年3月3日，飞机在纽约州奥尔巴尼县机场（现奥尔巴尼国际机场）进近时坠入奥尔巴尼市区的一栋房屋，造成17人死亡。

en.s: The 1973 Football League Cup final was held on 3 March 1973 and was won by Tottenham Hotspur. Spurs beat Norwich City 1–0 at the old Wembley. After 12 different teams had won the League Cup in its first 12 seasons, Spurs became the first team to win the competition for a second time.

zh.s: 1973年英格兰足球联赛杯决赛于3月3日举行，托特纳姆热刺队夺冠。热刺在旧温布利球场以1比0击败诺维奇城队。此前联赛杯前12届由12支不同球队夺冠，热刺成为首支第二次夺冠的球队。

en.s: General elections were held in Guatemala on 3 March 1974. No candidate received more than 50% of the vote in the presidential election, resulting in Kjell Eugenio Laugerud García being elected president by Congress on 12 March. The Congressional elections were won by an alliance of the Institutional Democratic Party and the National Liberation Movement. Voter turnout was 46.41% in the presidential election.

zh.s: 危地马拉于1974年3月3日举行大选。总统选举无人获得超过50%的选票，因此国会于3月12日选举谢尔·欧亨尼奥·劳赫鲁德·加西亚为总统。制度民主党与民族解放运动组成的联盟赢得国会选举，总统选举投票率为46.41%。

en.s: Turkish Airlines Flight 981 was a scheduled flight from Istanbul Yeşilköy Airport to London Heathrow Airport, with an intermediate stop at Orly Airport in Paris. On 3 March 1974, the McDonnell Douglas DC-10 operating the flight crashed into the Ermenonville Forest, about 40 kilometres (25 mi; 22 nmi) outside Paris, killing all 335 passengers and 11 crew. The crash was also known as the Ermenonville air disaster.

zh.t: 土耳其航空981号班机空难
zh.s: 土耳其航空981号班机是从伊斯坦布尔耶希尔柯伊机场出发、经停巴黎奥利机场、飞往伦敦希思罗机场的定期航班。1974年3月3日，执飞的麦克唐纳道格拉斯DC-10坠毁于巴黎外约40公里的埃尔默农维尔森林，机上335名乘客及11名机组人员全部遇难。距离约合25英里或22海里，此事也称埃尔默农维尔空难。

en.s: The 1981 Burlington mayoral election was held March 3, 1981. Bernie Sanders, who ran as an independent candidate, defeated incumbent Democratic Mayor Gordon Paquette, who was seeking a sixth term as Mayor of Burlington, Vermont, and Richard Bove. Paquette had easily won reelection to the mayoralty in the 1973, 1975, and 1979 elections and the Democratic Party controlled ten of the thirteen city council seats.

zh.t: 1981年佛蒙特州伯灵顿市长选举
zh.s: 1981年3月3日，佛蒙特州伯灵顿举行市长选举。独立候选人伯尼·桑德斯击败寻求第六次连任的现任民主党市长戈登·帕盖特和理查德·博夫。帕盖特曾轻松赢得1973、1975和1979年的市长选举，民主党当时控制了市议会13个席位中的10席。

en.s: On 3 March 1982, opposition politician and leader of the MLPC party, Ange-Félix Patassé, returned from exile to the Central African Republic and staged an unsuccessful coup against General André Kolingba (who himself took power in the 1981 coup d'état) with the help of a few military officers, such as General François Bozizé, who accused Kolingba of treason and proclaimed the change of power in a radio announcement.

zh.s: 1982年3月3日，中非共和国反对派政治家、人民解放运动党领袖安热-费利克斯·帕塔塞结束流亡回国，在少数军官协助下，企图推翻安德烈·科林巴将军，但未成功。科林巴本人在1981年政变中掌权。参与者包括弗朗索瓦·博齐泽将军，他指责科林巴叛国，并通过广播宣布权力更替。

en.s: A megathrust earthquake measuring 8.0 Mw struck just offshore the Greater Valparaíso area of Central Chile on 3 March 1985. The event followed a ten-day period of moderate and non-destructive foreshocks and left at least 177 people dead and about 2,500 injured. According to several reports, a small sector of damage in Llolleo corresponded to a maximum Mercalli intensity of IX (Violent), though the vast majority of damage was considered to align with intensity VIII (Severe) effects or less.

zh.s: 1985年3月3日，智利中部瓦尔帕莱索大区近海发生矩震级8.0级逆冲型地震。此前十天当地有一系列中等强度、未造成破坏的前震。地震造成至少177人死亡、约2,500人受伤。据多份报告，利奥列奥一小片区域的破坏达到麦加利烈度IX级（剧烈），但绝大多数地区的破坏程度为VIII级（严重）或更低。

en.s: The 1987 Tampa mayoral election took place on March 3, 1987. Incumbent Mayor Sandra Freedman ran for election to a full term. Freedman became mayor on July 16, 1986, when Mayor Bob Martinez resigned from office to run for governor. Prior to Martinez's resignation, Freedman had already announced that she would run to succeed him, and raised a significant amount of money.

zh.s: 美国坦帕于1987年3月3日举行市长选举，现任市长桑德拉·弗里德曼争取一个完整任期。鲍勃·马丁内斯市长于1986年7月16日辞职竞选州长后，弗里德曼接任。在马丁内斯辞职前，她已宣布竞选接替他，并筹得大量资金。

en.s: The 1987 Burlington, Vermont mayoral election was held on March 3, 1987. Incumbent Mayor Bernie Sanders won election to his fourth and final term as mayor with 55.23% of the popular vote against Democratic nominee Paul Lafayette, a member of the city council. Sanders ran his final independent campaign for mayor stating that he would not seek reelection to another term after 1987.

zh.t: 1987年佛蒙特州伯灵顿市长选举
zh.s: 1987年3月3日，伯灵顿市长选举举行。现任市长伯尼·桑德斯以55.23%的普选票胜出，开启第四个也是最后一个任期，击败民主党候选人、市议员保罗·拉法耶特。桑德斯最后一次以独立候选人身份竞选，并表示1987年后不会再寻求连任。

en.s: The 37th annual Berlin International Film Festival was held from 20 February to 3 March 1987. The Golden Bear was awarded to the Soviet film Tema, directed by Gleb Panfilov. The retrospective was in honour of Armenian-American film and theatre director Rouben Mamoulian. The homage was dedicated to French couple Jean-Louis Barrault, actor and director, and Madeleine Renaud, actress. It was titled Renaud-Barrault au cinéma.

en.s: The Fourth National Parliamentary Elections 1988 (Bengali: চতুর্থ জাতীয় সংসদ নির্বাচন ১৯৮৮) were held in Bangladesh on 3 March 1988. The elections were boycotted by several major parties, including the Bangladesh Awami League, the Bangladesh Nationalist Party, the Communist Party of Bangladesh, Jamaat-e-Islami Bangladesh, the Bangladesh Krishak Sramik Awami League, the National Awami Party (Muzaffar) and the Workers Party of Bangladesh. The result was a victory for the Jatiya Party, which won 251 of the 300 seats. Voter turnout was 52.5%.

zh.s: 孟加拉国于1988年3月3日举行第四届国民议会选举。多个主要政党抵制投票，包括人民联盟、民族主义党、共产党、伊斯兰大会党、农工人民联盟、全国人民党穆扎法尔派及工人党。民族党在300席中赢得251席，取得胜利。投票率为52.5%。

en.t: 1988 Turks and Caicos Islands general election
en.s: General elections were held in the Turks and Caicos Islands on 3 March 1988. They were the first after the suspension of the islands' constitution between 1986 and 1988, which followed Chief Minister Norman Saunders leaving office in March 1985 after being arrested on suspicion of drug smuggling (he was later found guilty and jailed) and the next Chief Minister Nathaniel Francis resigning in July 1986 after a British parliamentary inquiry accused him of corruption.

zh.t: 1988年特克斯和凯科斯群岛大选
zh.s: 特克斯和凯科斯群岛于1988年3月3日举行大选，是1986年至1988年宪法被暂停实施后的首次选举。此前，首席部长诺曼·桑德斯因涉嫌走私毒品被捕，于1985年3月离任，后来被判有罪入狱。继任的纳撒尼尔·弗朗西斯又因英国议会调查指控其腐败，于1986年7月辞职。

en.s: The 1989 Burlington, Vermont mayoral election was held on March 3, 1989. Incumbent Independent Mayor Bernie Sanders did not seek reelection to a fifth term. Peter Clavelle ran as an independent candidate, with the support of the Progressive Coalition, and defeated Democratic nominee Nancy Chioffi. Chioffi, a member of the city council, defeated city councilor Bill Aswad and Rick Sharp for the Democratic nomination.

zh.t: 1989年佛蒙特州伯灵顿市长选举
zh.s: 1989年3月3日，伯灵顿举行市长选举。现任独立市长伯尼·桑德斯没有竞选第五个任期。获得进步联盟支持的独立候选人彼得·克拉维尔击败民主党候选人南希·乔奥菲。乔奥菲是市议员，她在民主党提名中击败了市议员比尔·阿斯瓦德和里克·夏普。

en.s: Presidential elections were held for the first time in São Tomé and Príncipe on 3 March 1991, as previously the President had been elected by the National Assembly. Ultimately only one candidate, Miguel Trovoada, ran for office, and was elected unopposed. He was sworn in as the second president of São Tomé and Príncipe on 3 April.

zh.t: 1991年圣多美和普林西比总统选举
zh.s: 圣多美和普林西比于1991年3月3日首次举行总统选举，此前总统由国民议会选出。最终只有米格尔·特罗瓦达一人参选，无竞争当选。他于4月3日宣誓就任，成为该国第二任总统。

en.s: United Airlines Flight 585 was a scheduled passenger flight on March 3, 1991, from Denver to Colorado Springs, Colorado, carrying 20 passengers and 5 crew members. The Boeing 737-200 experienced a rudder hardover while on final approach to runway 35 at Colorado Springs Municipal Airport, causing the plane to roll over and enter an uncontrolled dive. All on board died on impact.

zh.s: 联合航空585号班机于1991年3月3日执飞从丹佛飞往科罗拉多斯普林斯的定期客运航班，机上有20名乘客和5名机组人员。波音737-200客机在科罗拉多斯普林斯市政机场35号跑道进近时，方向舵突然偏转，导致飞机翻滚并失控俯冲。机上人员全部在撞击中遇难。

en.s: The 1991 Burlington, Vermont mayoral election was held on March 3, 1991 to elect the mayor of Burlington, Vermont. Incumbent independent Mayor Peter Clavelle ran as the candidate of the Progressive Coalition, and defeated Haik Bedrosian, Daniel Gregory, and Michael Hackett, who all ran as independent candidates. The Democratic and Republican parties did not run candidates in this election. Clavelle faced no opposition for the endorsement of the Progressive Coalition.

zh.t: 1991年佛蒙特州伯灵顿市长选举
zh.s: 1991年3月3日，佛蒙特州伯灵顿举行市长选举。现任独立市长彼得·克拉维尔代表进步联盟参选，击败了同为独立候选人的海克·贝德罗西安、丹尼尔·格雷戈里和迈克尔·哈克特。民主党和共和党都没有派出候选人。克拉维尔在进步联盟内部没有遇到提名竞争。

en.s: 1995 Empress's Cup Final was the 17th final of the Empress's Cup competition. The final was played at Nishigaoka Soccer Stadium in Tokyo on March 3, 1996. Fujita SC Mercury won the championship.

zh.s: 1995年皇后杯决赛是该项赛事的第17届决赛，于1996年3月3日在东京西丘足球场举行。藤田SC水星队夺得冠军。

en.s: A regional election was held in Andalusia on 3 March 1996 to elect the 5th Parliament of the autonomous community. All 109 seats in the Parliament were up for election. It was held concurrently with the 1996 Spanish general election. The 1994 election had resulted in a hung parliament.

zh.s: 1996年3月3日，安达卢西亚举行自治区选举，选出第五届自治区议会全部109名议员。选举与1996年西班牙大选同时举行。此前的1994年选举产生了一个没有多数党的议会。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Benin in March 1996. The first round, held on 3 March (or 4 March), saw no candidate gain over 50% of the vote, resulting in a second round held on 18 March. Mathieu Kérékou, a former military dictator who had come second in the first round, was victorious in the second round, beating incumbent Nicéphore Soglo, after gaining the backing of the third- and fourth-placed candidates.

en.s: On March 3, 2005, James Roszko shot and killed four Royal Canadian Mounted Police constables who were assisting in a criminal investigation at his property near Mayerthorpe, Alberta, Canada. Roszko then took his own life.

Dennis O'Rourke received the 2005 Don Dunstan Award for his contribution to the Australian film industry. The poster this year depicts two children shining a light on the festival theme, Image is Everything.

en.s: The 2008 Alberta general election was held on March 3, 2008, to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of Alberta. It was expected to be called early because the governing Progressive Conservatives held a leadership election on December 2, 2006, in which Ed Stelmach was elected to replace Ralph Klein as party leader and Premier.

zh.s: 2008年3月3日，艾伯塔省举行大选，选出艾伯塔省立法议会议员。原本预计选举会提前举行，因为执政的进步保守党于2006年12月2日举行党魁选举，选出埃德·斯泰尔马克接替拉尔夫·克莱因担任党魁和省长。

en.s: The Burlington mayoral election of 2009 occurred on Tuesday, March 3, 2009. Burlington's mayoral race is partisan election that occurs every three years, and there are no term limits. The current mayor, Bob Kiss, has served since 2006. This marks the second mayoral election in Burlington using instant runoff voting (IRV). Unlike Burlington's first IRV mayoral election in 2006, the IRV winner in 2009 (Bob Kiss) was neither the same as the plurality winner (Kurt Wright) nor Condorcet winner (Andy Montroll). There was post-election controversy regarding the IRV method, mostly from supporters of Kurt Wright, the plurality winner of first-choice rankings.

zh.s: 佛蒙特州伯灵顿于2009年3月3日星期二举行市长选举。该市选举有党派之分，每三年举行一次，没有任期限制，现任市长鲍勃·基斯自2006年执政。这是该市第二次采用即时决选制，即按选民排序逐轮淘汰并转移选票。与2006年首次采用时不同，2009年胜出的基斯，既不是首选票最多的库尔特·赖特，也不是在逐一对决中均能胜出的安迪·蒙特罗尔。选后投票制度引发争议，批评主要来自首选票领先者赖特的支持者。

en.s: The 2009 elections for elected officials in Los Angeles took place on March 3, 2009, with run-off elections on May 19, 2009. The mayor, city attorney, city controller and eight out of the fifteen members of the city council were up for election.

zh.s: 2009年3月3日，洛杉矶举行公职选举，第二轮选举于同年5月19日举行。市长、市检察官、市审计长和市议会15个席位中的8席都在本次选举中改选。

en.s: The 2009 Los Angeles mayoral election took place on March 3, 2009. Incumbent mayor Antonio R. Villaraigosa was re-elected overwhelmingly and faced no serious opponent. Villaraigosa would have faced a run-off against second place-finisher Walter Moore had he failed to win a majority of the vote. Villaraigosa won the election despite having generally unfavorable approval ratings.

zh.s: 2009年3月3日，洛杉矶举行市长选举。现任市长安东尼奥·维拉莱戈萨以压倒性优势连任，没有遇到有力对手。若他未能获得过半选票，就必须与第二名沃尔特·摩尔进行第二轮投票。尽管他的支持率普遍不高，维拉莱戈萨仍赢得选举。

en.s: The action of 3 March 2009 took place when the German Bremen-class frigate Rheinland-Pfalz chased and captured a pirate skiff in the Gulf of Aden, after the persons on board the small vessel fired at and attempted to stop the German-owned tanker MV Courier. The operation marked the first time that the German Navy captured a hostile vessel at sea since World War II.

zh.s: 2009年3月3日，德国不来梅级护卫舰“莱茵兰-普法尔茨号”在亚丁湾追赶并俘获一艘海盗快艇。此前，快艇上的人员向德国籍“信使号”油轮开火并试图拦截该船。自第二次世界大战以来，这是德国海军首次在海上俘获敌对船只。

en.t: 2009 attack on the Sri Lanka national cricket team
en.s: On 3 March 2009, a bus carrying Sri Lankan cricketers, part of a larger convoy, was fired upon by 12 gunmen near Gaddafi Stadium in Lahore, Pakistan. The cricketers were on their way to play the third day of the second Test against the Pakistani cricket team. Six members of the Sri Lanka national cricket team were wounded and six Pakistani policemen and two civilians were killed.

zh.t: 2009年斯里兰卡国家板球队遇袭
zh.s: 2009年3月3日，一辆载有斯里兰卡板球运动员的大巴在一支大型车队中行驶，途经巴基斯坦拉合尔的卡扎菲体育场附近时遭12名枪手袭击。球员正准备参加对阵巴基斯坦队的第二场测试赛第三天比赛。斯里兰卡国家队6人受伤，另有6名巴基斯坦警察和2名平民遇难。

en.s: Municipal elections were held on Wednesday 3 March 2010 in most municipalities in the Netherlands. This election determined the composition of the municipal councils for the following four years. The elections were held a few weeks after the fall of the Fourth Balkenende cabinet. Nearly 24% of the vote went to local parties and independent candidates, more than any national political party.

zh.s: 2010年3月3日星期三，荷兰大部分市镇举行选举，决定未来四年的市镇议会组成。投票发生在第四届巴尔克嫩德内阁倒台数周后。地方政党及独立候选人获得近24%的选票，超过任何一个全国性政党。

en.s: The Barnsley Central by-election was a by-election for the Parliament of the United Kingdom's House of Commons constituency of Barnsley Central which took place on 3 March 2011. The by-election resulted in the Labour Party holding the seat with an increased majority.

zh.s: 2011年3月3日，英国下议院巴恩斯利中央选区举行补选，工党以更大的领先优势保住议席。

en.s: The Goa legislative assembly election was held on 3 March 2012, to select the 40 members of the Vidhan Sabha. The result was announced on 6 March. The Bharatiya Janata Party-Maharashtrawadi Gomantak alliance defeated the incumbent Indian National Congress government in Goa led by Chief Minister Digambar Kamat with 24 seats in the 40-seat assembly. The Bharatiya Janata Party won 21 seats, while the Maharashtrawadi Gomantak Party won 3 seats. The MLA with the biggest margin of victory was the Roman Catholic incumbent MLA Frances D'Souza of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). Former chief minister Manohar Parrikar was sworn in as the new chief minister.

zh.s: 印度果阿邦于2012年3月3日举行选举，选出40名邦议员，3月6日公布结果。印度人民党与马哈拉施特拉果阿人党组成的联盟赢得24席，击败迪甘巴尔·卡马特首席部长领导的国大党政府。其中人民党21席，盟友3席。获胜票差最大的议员是人民党的天主教徒、现任议员弗朗西斯·德索萨。前首席部长马诺哈尔·帕里卡尔随后宣誓重新出任首席部长。

en.s: The 2012 Washington Republican presidential caucuses were held on March 3, 2012. Since 1992, the Washington Republicans have used a presidential preferential primary in addition to the caucuses. The 2012 primary was, however, canceled for budgetary reasons, as was the one in 2004.

zh.t: 2012年华盛顿州共和党总统党团会议
zh.s: 华盛顿州于2012年3月3日举行共和党总统党团会议。自1992年以来，该州共和党除党团会议外，还会举行总统候选人偏好初选。但2012年初选因预算原因取消，与2004年的情况相同。

en.t: 2012 Portuguese Social Democratic Party leadership election
en.s: The 2012 Portuguese Social Democratic Party leadership election was held on 3 March 2012. Then PSD leader and Prime Minister Pedro Passos Coelho ran for a 2nd term as party leader and was the sole candidate in the race, thus winning with almost 95% of the votes.

zh.t: 2012年葡萄牙社会民主党党魁选举
zh.s: 2012年3月3日，葡萄牙社会民主党举行党魁选举。时任党魁兼总理佩德罗·帕索斯·科埃略竞选连任，是唯一候选人，最终获得近95%的选票。

en.t: The first World Pasty Championships are held at the Eden Project
en.s: The first World Pasty Championships were held at the Eden Project in Cornwall on Saturday, 3 March 2012. The event celebrated Cornish pasties and included amateur, professional, junior, and company categories.

zh.t: 首届世界馅饼锦标赛在康沃尔伊甸园举行
zh.s: 2012年3月3日，首届世界馅饼锦标赛在英国康沃尔的伊甸园举行。比赛以康沃尔馅饼为主题，设有业余、专业、青少年和企业组。

en.s: The 2012 Japanese Super Cup was a football competition held on 3 March 2012 between the 2011 J. League champions Kashiwa Reysol and the 2011 Emperor's Cup winner F.C. Tokyo. Kashiwa Reysol won the match 2–1 in regulation time.

zh.s: 2012年日本超级杯于2012年3月3日举行，由2011年J联赛冠军柏太阳神队对阵2011年天皇杯冠军FC东京队。柏太阳神队在常规时间内以2比1获胜。

en.s: The tenth election for the governorship of Bangkok took place on 3 March 2013. The election was won by incumbent governor MR Sukhumbhand Paribatra of the Democrat Party. Twenty-five candidates contested the election. Pol Gen Pongsapat Pongcharoen, representing the Pheu Thai Party, was regarded as the other major contender. The election was scheduled to take place sixty days after Sukhumbhand resigned on 9 January 2013, his second-to-last day of office. (Resignation, as opposed to completion of the term, effectively extended the election deadline for another fifteen days.) The Election Commission accepted registrations on 21–25 January, although unofficial campaigning had begun earlier.

zh.s: 曼谷于2013年3月3日举行第十次市长选举，民主党现任市长素坤攀·博里帕亲王获胜。共有25人参选，为泰党候选人、警察上将蓬沙帕·蓬乍伦被视为另一名主要竞争者。素坤攀于任期结束前倒数第二天，即1月9日辞职，因此选举定在辞职后60天内举行。与正常任满相比，提前辞职实际将选举期限延长15天。选举委员会于1月21日至25日接受登记，非正式竞选则更早开始。

en.s: The March 2013 Karachi bombing was a terrorist attack that struck a predominantly Shia area inside Abbas Town, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Town in Karachi, Pakistan on 3 March 2013. At least 48 people were killed and more than 180 others injured after a car bomb was detonated outside a Shia mosque, just as locals were leaving after the evening's services. As rescuers gathered to the scene of the bombings, a second blast caused even more destruction. Authorities suspected the Sunni militant group Lashkar-e Jhangvi of being behind the attacks. This was the first major incident within the city since a wave of target killings left more than 300 dead in the summer of 2011.

zh.s: 2013年3月3日，巴基斯坦卡拉奇古尔尚伊克巴尔镇阿巴斯镇内、以什叶派居民为主的地区遭恐怖袭击。傍晚礼拜结束、居民离开清真寺时，寺外汽车炸弹爆炸，造成至少48人死亡、180多人受伤。救援人员赶到后，第二次爆炸造成进一步破坏。当局怀疑逊尼派武装“羌城军”策划袭击。这是2011年夏季一轮定点杀戮造成300多人死亡后，该市首次重大袭击。

en.s: The Lower Austrian state election of 2013 was held in the Austrian state of Lower Austria on 3 March 2013. Since 2003 the Austrian People's Party has had a majority of the seats, the Team Stronach, which was standing for election in Lower Austria in the first time, won 5 seats, while the Social Democratic Party of Austria, like the Freedom Party of Austria, lost 2 seats and the Greens could defend their 4 seats.

en.s: The 2013 Carinthian state election was held on 3 March 2013 to elect the members of the Landtag of Carinthia. The election saw a massive shift in Carinthian politics, which had been dominated by the Freedom Party in Carinthia (FPK) and Governor Jörg Haider since the 1990s. After Haider's death in 2008, he was succeeded by Gerhard Dörfler.

zh.s: 2013年3月3日，克恩顿州举行选举，选出州议会议员。自20世纪90年代以来，克恩顿自由党和州长约尔格·海德尔一直主导当地政坛，这次选举令政局发生重大变化。海德尔于2008年去世后，由格哈德·德尔弗勒接任。

en.s: The 2013 Chinese FA Super Cup (Chinese: 2013中国足球协会超级杯) was the 11th Chinese FA Super Cup. The match was played at the Tianhe Stadium on 3 March 2013, contesting by Super League and FA Cup double winners Guangzhou Evergrande and Super League runners-up Jiangsu Sainty. Jiangsu Sainty defeated Guangzhou Evergrande 2–1, thus winning their first ever Chinese FA Super Cup title.

zh.s: 2013年中国足协超级杯是第十一届中国足协超级杯，于2013年3月3日在天河体育场举行。比赛由中超和足协杯双冠王广州恒大队对阵中超亚军江苏舜天队。江苏舜天队以2比1击败广州恒大队，首次夺得中国足协超级杯冠军。

en.s: The 2015 Los Angeles elections were held on March 3, 2015, in Los Angeles, California. Voters elected candidates in a nonpartisan primary, with runoff elections scheduled for May 19, 2015. Seven of the fifteen seats in the City Council were up for election. Municipal elections in California are officially nonpartisan; candidates' party affiliations do not appear on the ballot.

zh.s: 美国加利福尼亚州洛杉矶于2015年3月3日举行市级选举初选，改选市议会15席中的7席，第二轮定于5月19日。加州地方选举正式采用无党派形式，选票不列出候选人的政党归属。

en.s: The 2015 Burlington mayoral election was held March 3, 2015. Incumbent mayor Miro Weinberger, a Democrat, was re-elected for a second 3-year term with 68.27% of the vote. The Progressive nominee, Steven Goodkind, came in a second distant place with 22.35% of the vote. Weinberger was also challenged by independent Greg Guma and Libertarian Loyal Ploof.

zh.t: 2015年佛蒙特州伯灵顿市长选举
zh.s: 佛蒙特州伯灵顿于2015年3月3日举行市长选举。民主党现任市长米罗·温伯格以68.27%的选票连任，赢得第二个三年任期。进步党候选人史蒂文·古德金德以22.35%远远落后，排名第二。独立候选人格雷格·古马及自由意志党的洛亚尔·普卢夫也参加角逐。

en.s: The 2015 Wichita mayoral election took place on April 7, 2015, to elect the mayor of Wichita, Kansas. The election was held concurrently with various other local elections, and is officially nonpartisan. Incumbent mayor Carl Brewer, a Democrat, was term-limited and could not seek a third term in office. A primary election was held on March 3, 2015, to decide the two candidates that moved on to the general election.

en.s: The Bahraini King's Cup final was a match that took place on 3 March 2016 at the Bahrain National Stadium in Riffa to determine the winner of the 2016 Bahraini King's Cup. The winner of this match would guarantee a spot at the next year's AFC Cup edition. Muharraq defeated "Bahraini El-Classico" rivals Riffa in Riffa with 2 late goals by Ali Jamal and Jamal Rashid, to be crowned winners in front of a Muharraq-heavy audience.

zh.s: 2016年巴林国王杯决赛于3月3日在里法的巴林国家体育场举行，胜者可取得次年亚足联杯参赛资格。穆哈拉格凭借阿里·贾迈勒与贾迈勒·拉希德的两粒晚段进球，击败“巴林国家德比”对手里法，在大多支持穆哈拉格的观众面前夺冠。

en.s: The Sinjar clashes of 3 March 2017 occurred between pro-PKK forces, namely the Sinjar Resistance Units (YBŞ) and the Êzîdxan Women's Units (YJÊ), and the Rojava Peshmerga that serve as the Kurdish National Council's paramilitary wing. After KNC forces entered the town of Khanasor in the Iraqi Sinjar Mountains, fighting boke out among unclear circumstances, resulting in dozens of casualties.

zh.s: 2017年3月3日，亲库尔德工人党的辛贾尔抵抗部队及埃兹迪汗女子部队，与库尔德全国委员会准军事组织罗贾瓦佩什梅格发生冲突。后者进入伊拉克辛贾尔山脉的哈纳索尔镇后，双方在原因尚不明确的情况下开战，造成数十人伤亡。

en.s: The Gulf of Sidra Offensive was an offensive of the Second Libyan Civil War. It was launched by the Benghazi Defense Brigades on 3 March 2017, and initially resulted in them taking control of a strip of coastal territory between the towns of Nofaliya and Ras Lanuf, which was then handed over to the Government of National Accord.

zh.s: 2017年3月3日，班加西保卫旅在第二次利比亚内战中发动锡德拉湾攻势，最初夺取努法利亚与拉斯拉努夫之间的一段沿海地区，随后将其移交民族团结政府。

en.s: Triennial Senate elections were in Pakistan held on 3 March 2018 to replace 52 retiring senators - half of the Senate's strength - with the winning candidates serving six-year terms. Overall, Pakistan Muslim League (N) came out as the largest party, followed by the Pakistan Peoples Party and the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf.

zh.s: 巴基斯坦于2018年3月3日举行每三年一次的参议院选举，接替52名任满议员，占参议院人数一半，新当选者任期六年。巴基斯坦穆斯林联盟谢里夫派成为第一大党，其后为巴基斯坦人民党及正义运动党。

en.s: UFC 222: Cyborg vs. Kunitskaya was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that was held on March 3, 2018, at the T-Mobile Arena in Paradise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas metropolitan area. UFC 222 features in the film Road House with filming taking place at the T-Mobile Arena during UFC 285.

zh.s: “UFC 222：赛博格对库尼茨卡娅”是终极格斗冠军赛举办的综合格斗赛事，于2018年3月3日在内华达州帕拉代斯的T-Mobile竞技场举行，属于拉斯维加斯都会区。影片《新威龙杀阵》中出现了UFC 222，相关画面则是在UFC 285期间于T-Mobile竞技场拍摄。

en.t: 2018 Saskatchewan New Democratic Party leadership election
en.s: An election for the leadership of the Saskatchewan New Democratic Party was held on March 3, 2018, as a result of the resignation of Cam Broten after losing the seat he contested in the 2016 election. Ryan Meili was chosen leader.

zh.t: 2018年萨斯喀彻温省新民主党党魁选举
zh.s: 萨斯喀彻温省新民主党于2018年3月3日举行党魁选举。时任党魁卡姆·布罗滕在2016年选举中失去议席后辞职，因此触发了这次选举。瑞安·梅利当选新党魁。

en.s: The Battle of Batibo occurred on 3 March 2018, when Ambazonian separatists attacked Cameroonian troops on the Bamenda-Batibo Highway, Batibo Subdivision. At the time, it was reportedly the deadliest clash between Cameroonian and Ambazonian forces to date.

zh.s: 2018年3月3日，安巴佐尼亚分离主义者在巴蒂博区的班门达—巴蒂博公路上袭击喀麦隆军队，巴蒂博战役由此爆发。据报道，这是当时喀麦隆部队与安巴佐尼亚部队之间伤亡最惨重的冲突。

en.s: The 2018 Tasmanian state election was held on 3 March 2018 to elect all 25 members of the Tasmanian House of Assembly. The four-year incumbent Liberal government, led by Premier Will Hodgman, won a second consecutive term. It defeated the Labor Party, led by Opposition Leader Rebecca White, and the Greens, led by Cassy O'Connor.

zh.s: 2018年3月3日，塔斯马尼亚州举行选举，改选州众议院全部25个席位。时任州长威尔·霍奇曼领导的自由党政府连任，连续第二次赢得选举，击败了由反对党领袖丽贝卡·怀特领导的工党和由卡西·奥康纳领导的绿党。

en.s: On March 3, 2018, Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki held KSW 42: Khalidov vs. Narkun, a mixed martial arts event, at Atlas Arena in Łódź, Poland.

zh.s: “IWRG面具对头发：2019年3月”是墨西哥国际摔角革命集团（IWRG）策划并安排剧情的大型墨西哥自由式摔角赛事，于2019年3月3日在墨西哥州瑙卡尔潘竞技场举行。原文在开始介绍这场赛事的核心比赛时中断。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Estonia on 3 March 2019. The newly elected 101 members of the 14th Riigikogu assembled at Toompea Castle in Tallinn within ten days of the election. The Reform Party remained the largest party, gaining four seats for a total of 34 and the Conservative People's Party had the largest gain overall, increasing their seat count by 12 to a total of 19 seats.

zh.s: 爱沙尼亚于2019年3月3日举行议会选举。第14届议会101名新议员，在选后十天内到塔林座堂山城堡开会。改革党增加4席，达到34席，继续保持第一大党地位；保守人民党增幅最大，增加12席，达到19席。

en.s: The 2019 Democratic Party leadership election was an open primary election held on 3 March 2019. The election was triggered by the resignation of Matteo Renzi on 12 March 2018, following the party's defeat at the 2018 general election. Vice Secretary Maurizio Martina was appointed Secretary in July 2018 by the National Assembly, but he resigned after few months to officially start the party's congress.

zh.t: 2019年意大利民主党领导人选举
zh.s: 意大利民主党于2019年3月3日举行开放式领导人初选。该党在2018年大选失利后，马泰奥·伦齐于3月12日辞职。副书记毛里齐奥·马蒂纳在2018年7月获全国代表大会任命为书记，但数月后辞职，正式启动党代表大会程序，随后举行这次选举。

en.t: 2020 Orange County Board of Supervisors election
en.s: The 2020 Orange County Board of Supervisors elections were held on March 3, 2020 and November 3, 2020. Two of the five seats of the Orange County, California Board of Supervisors were up for election. County elections in California are officially nonpartisan. A two-round system was used for the election, starting with the first round in March; followed by a runoff in November between the top-two candidates in each district.

en.s: The 2020 California Democratic presidential primary took place on March 3, 2020, as one of 15 contests scheduled on Super Tuesday in the Democratic Party primaries for the 2020 presidential election, following the South Carolina primary the weekend before. en.s: The 2020 Oklahoma Republican presidential primary took place on March 3, 2020, as one of fourteen contests scheduled for Super Tuesday in the Republican Party presidential primaries for the 2020 presidential election. Incumbent United States president Donald Trump was challenged by five candidates: businessman and perennial candidate Rocky De La Fuente of California, entrepreneur and investor Bob Ely of Massachusetts, entrepreneur and attorney Matthew Matern of Louisiana, transhumanist activist Zoltan Istvan of California, and former congressman Joe Walsh of Illinois.

en.s: The 2020 Arkansas Republican presidential primary took place on Super Tuesday, March 3, 2020. It used the "Winner takes most" system of allocating delegates. This system states that a candidate must receive 15% of the vote to receive any delegates statewide or by congressional district, but only if the winner gets less than 50% of the aggregate vote. Should they do so, it becomes winner-take-all.

Garcia's win was the first time Republicans flipped a Democratic-held House seat in California since 1998.

zh.t: 2020年加利福尼亚州第25国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 加利福尼亚州第25国会选区于2020年3月3日举行联邦众议员特别选举，与州总统初选同日。因无人获得过半数选票，前两名克里斯蒂·史密斯和迈克·加西亚于5月12日进入第二轮。加西亚胜出，使共和党自1998年以来首次在加州夺得民主党原有的联邦众议院议席。

en.s: The 2020 Oklahoma Democratic presidential primary took place on March 3, 2020, as one of 15 contests scheduled on Super Tuesday in the Democratic Party primaries for the 2020 presidential election, following the South Carolina primary the weekend before. The Oklahoma primary was a semi-closed primary, with the state awarding 43 delegates towards the 2020 Democratic National Convention, 37 of whom were pledged delegates allocated on the basis of the results of the primary.

zh.t: 2020年俄克拉何马州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 俄克拉何马州于2020年3月3日举行民主党总统初选，是“超级星期二”安排的15场民主党提名竞逐之一，在前一个周末的南卡罗来纳初选之后进行。这是半封闭式初选，共涉及全国代表大会的43名代表，其中37名须按结果分配并支持相应候选人。

en.s: The 2020 Vermont Republican presidential primary took place on March 3, 2020, as one of 14 contests scheduled for Super Tuesday in the Republican Party primaries for the 2020 presidential election.

zh.t: 2020年佛蒙特州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 佛蒙特州于2020年3月3日举行共和党总统初选，是该党当届总统候选人提名程序中，“超级星期二”安排的14场竞逐之一。

en.s: The 2020 Massachusetts Republican presidential primary took place on March 3, 2020, as one of fourteen contests scheduled for Super Tuesday in the Republican Party presidential primaries for the 2020 presidential election.

zh.t: 2020年马萨诸塞州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 马萨诸塞州于2020年3月3日举行共和党总统初选，是该党当届总统候选人提名程序中，“超级星期二”安排的14场竞逐之一。

en.s: The 2020 North Carolina Republican presidential primary took place on March 3, 2020, as one of fourteen contests scheduled for Super Tuesday in the Republican Party presidential primaries for the 2020 presidential election.

zh.t: 2020年北卡罗来纳州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 北卡罗来纳州于2020年3月3日举行共和党总统初选，是该党当届总统候选人提名程序中，“超级星期二”安排的14场竞逐之一。

en.s: The 2020 Texas Democratic presidential primary took place on March 3, 2020, as one of 15 contests scheduled on Super Tuesday in the Democratic Party primaries for the 2020 presidential election, following the South Carolina primary the weekend before. The Texas primary was an open primary, with the state awarding the second-largest amount of national convention delegates on Super Tuesday and third-largest amount overall: 260 delegates, of which 228 were pledged delegates allocated on the basis of the primary.

zh.t: 2020年得克萨斯州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 得克萨斯州于2020年3月3日举行民主党总统初选，是“超级星期二”安排的15场民主党提名竞逐之一，在前一个周末的南卡罗来纳初选之后进行。这是开放式初选，共涉及全国代表大会的260名代表，数量在“超级星期二”各地中排第二，在整个提名程序中排第三。其中228名须按初选结果分配并支持相应候选人。

en.t: 2020 Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors election
en.s: The 2020 Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors elections took place on March 3, 2020, with runoff elections held on November 3, 2020, to elect members of the Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors. Three of the five seats on the board were up for election. With the election of Holly Mitchell in the second district, the board of supervisors consisted entirely of women for the first time in history.

zh.s: 2020年3月3日，洛杉矶县举行监事会选举，第二轮投票于同年11月3日举行。监事会五个席位中有三个需要改选。霍莉·米切尔当选第二选区监事后，监事会历史上首次全部由女性组成。

en.s: Bakersfield, California, held a general election for mayor on March 3, 2020. It saw the re-election of incumbent Karen Goh. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan.

zh.t: 2020年加利福尼亚州贝克斯菲尔德市长选举
zh.s: 2020年3月3日，加利福尼亚州贝克斯菲尔德举行市长普选，现任市长凯伦·戈成功连任。加州市政选举不设党派标签。

en.s: The 2020 Sacramento mayoral election was held on March 3, 2020 to elect the mayor of Sacramento, California. It saw the reelection of Darrell Steinberg. Since Steinberg won a majority in the first round, no runoff was required. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan.

zh.s: 2020年3月3日，加利福尼亚州萨克拉门托举行市长选举，达雷尔·斯坦伯格成功连任。他在首轮投票中获得过半票数，因此不必举行第二轮。加州市政选举不设党派标签。

en.s: Stockton, California, held an election for mayor on March 3, 2020, with a runoff election held on November 3, 2020. Despite a strong performance in the primary, incumbent Democrat Michael Tubbs was defeated by Republican Kevin Lincoln in the general election. Municipal elections in California are officially nonpartisan; candidates' party affiliations do not appear on the ballot.

zh.t: 2020年加利福尼亚州斯托克顿市长选举
zh.s: 2020年3月3日，加利福尼亚州斯托克顿举行市长选举，第二轮投票于同年11月3日举行。现任民主党市长迈克尔·塔布斯虽在初选中表现强劲，仍在普选中败给共和党人凯文·林肯。加州市政选举不设党派标签，候选人的党派不会印在选票上。

en.s: The 2020 Fresno mayoral election was held on March 3, 2020, to elect the mayor of Fresno, California. Republican Jerry Dyer was elected after winning a majority in the primary. Incumbent mayor Lee Brand did not run for a second term. It was the first time in the city's history in which an incumbent eligible for re-election chose to retire the seat.

zh.s: 2020年3月3日，加利福尼亚州弗雷斯诺举行市长选举，共和党人杰里·戴尔在初选中获得过半票数，当选市长。现任市长李·布兰德没有竞选连任。这是该市历史上首次有具备连任资格的现任市长主动放弃竞选。

en.s: The 2020 Los Angeles elections were held on March 3, 2020. Voters elected candidates in a nonpartisan primary, with runoff elections scheduled for November 3, 2020. Seven of the 15 seats in the City Council were up for election. This was the first election held in the city that correlated with recent changes in election laws, which moved elections from being held on off-years to even-numbered years to correlate with federal and state elections.

zh.s: 2020年3月3日，洛杉矶举行市选举。选民参加无党派初选，第二轮投票定于同年11月3日举行。市议会15个席位中有7席改选。这是洛杉矶首次按照最近通过的选举法调整日期举行选举：此前市选举在非联邦选举年份举行，之后改为偶数年份，以配合联邦和州选举。

en.s: The 2020 Massachusetts Democratic presidential primary took place on March 3, as one of 15 contests scheduled on Super Tuesday in the Democratic Party primaries for the 2020 presidential election, following the South Carolina primary the weekend before. The Massachusetts primary was a semi-closed primary, with the state awarding 114 delegates towards the 2020 Democratic National Convention, of which 91 were pledged delegates allocated on the basis of the results of the primary.

zh.t: 2020年马萨诸塞州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2020年马萨诸塞州民主党总统初选于3月3日举行，是民主党总统初选“超级星期二”安排的15场投票之一，前一周末刚举行南卡罗来纳州初选。这是一场半开放式初选，马萨诸塞州共分配114名代表，参加2020年民主党全国代表大会，其中91名为承诺代表，按初选结果分配。

en.s: The March 2020 Daraa clashes was an armed conflict between rebel fighters aligned with the Free Syrian Army and Syrian government forces in the Daraa Governorate. Clashes began after the start of a government security operation against FSA insurgent cells in Al-Sanamayn and other areas in the Daraa governorate that have been active since 2018 after the defeat of rebel forces in the province.

zh.s: 2020年3月，德拉省发生反政府武装与叙利亚政府军之间的武装冲突。反政府武装与自由叙利亚军结盟。政府在德拉省萨纳迈因及其他地区开展安全行动后，冲突随之爆发；自2018年政府击败该省反政府武装以来，这些地区一直活跃着自由叙利亚军残余组织。

en.s: Municipal elections were held in Belize on 3 March 2021. Voters elected a total 67 representatives. This includes a mayor in each of the nine communities, 42 town councils and 16 city councillors (ten in Belize City and six in Belmopan). This election saw another historic consecutive landslide victory for the People's United Party which won all 9 municipalities and 65 of the 67 municipal seats with the United Democratic Party (UDP) losing 38 municipal seats and only managing to hold on to two.

zh.s: 伯利兹于2021年3月3日举行地方选举，选出67名代表，包括九个市镇各一名市长、42名镇议员，以及16名市议员，其中伯利兹市10名、贝尔莫潘6名。人民联合党再次取得历史性的压倒性胜利，赢下全部九个市镇及67席中的65席。联合民主党失去38席，仅保住2席。

en.s: The 2021 Pakistani Senate election was held on 3 March 2021. The Election commission of Pakistan announced the election schedule on 11 February 2021. 52 of the 104 Senators had retired on 7 February 2021. After the merger of the Federally Administered Tribal Areas with Khyber Pakhtunkhawa, FATA seats were abolished and there was no election on 4 of the 8 seats.

zh.s: 巴基斯坦于2021年3月3日举行参议院选举，选举委员会在2月11日公布日程。104名参议员中的52人已于2月7日任满。联邦直辖部落地区并入开伯尔—普什图省后，该地区议席被撤销，原有8席中的4席不再进行选举。

en.s: Early presidential elections were held in Armenia on 3 March 2022, following President Armen Sarkissian's resignation on 23 January 2022.

zh.s: 总统阿尔缅·萨尔基相于2022年1月23日辞职后，亚美尼亚于3月3日提前举行总统选举。

en.s: A by-election for the United Kingdom parliamentary constituency of Birmingham Erdington was held on 3 March 2022, following the death of incumbent Labour Party Member of Parliament (MP) Jack Dromey. It was won by Paulette Hamilton, who held the seat for Labour on an increased majority.

zh.t: 2022年伯明翰埃尔丁顿选区补选
zh.s: 英国伯明翰埃尔丁顿选区于2022年3月3日举行议会补选，填补工党议员杰克·德罗米去世留下的空缺。波莱特·汉密尔顿当选，以更大的领先优势为工党保住议席。

en.s: In early March 2022, a military engagement took place in the small city of Voznesensk, Ukraine, as part of the southern front of the Russian invasion of Ukraine. After surrounding the city of Kherson, Russian forces advanced west towards the city of Mykolaiv. While Russian forces attacked Mykolaiv, a Russian column detached and pushed north, engaging Ukrainian forces at Voznesensk.

zh.s: 2022年3月初，俄乌战争南部战线在乌克兰小城沃兹涅先斯克发生战斗。俄军包围赫尔松后向西推进，目标是尼古拉耶夫。俄军进攻尼古拉耶夫期间，一支俄军纵队分兵向北推进，在沃兹涅先斯克遭遇乌军。

en.s: ONE Friday Fights 7: Rambolek vs. Theeradet (also known as ONE Lumpinee 7) was a combat sport event produced by ONE Championship that took place on March 3, 2023, at Lumpinee Boxing Stadium in Bangkok, Thailand.

zh.s: ONE Friday Fights 7：兰波莱克对阵提拉德（也称ONE Lumpinee 7）是一场由ONE冠军赛主办的格斗赛事，于2023年3月3日在泰国曼谷伦披尼拳击场举行。

en.s: The 2024 Thai League 3 Cup final was the culmination of the 2023–24 Thai League 3 Cup, the inaugural edition of Thailand's knockout football competition organized by the Football Association of Thailand (FA Thailand). The final occurred at BG Stadium in Pathum Thani, Thailand, on 3 March 2024, featuring Phatthalung and Maejo United. Phatthalung, representing the Southern region of the 2023–24 Thai League 3, carried the name and pride of Phatthalung Province into the final.

zh.s: 2024年泰国丙级联赛杯决赛，于3月3日在泰国巴吞他尼的BG体育场举行，由博他仑对阵梅州联。这是泰国足协新创办的2023—24赛季淘汰赛的最后一场。博他仑来自该赛季泰丙南部赛区，代表博他仑府进入决赛。

en.s: The 2024 Charity Cup was the 20th Charity Cup, an annual football match played between the winners of the previous season's New Zealand National League and Chatham Cup competitions. It took place at Martin Luckie Park on 3 March 2024. This was the first edition since the introduction of the National League in 2021. As the home side, Wellington Olympic selected Heart Kids New Zealand as their charity.

zh.s: 2024年慈善杯是第二十届赛事，每年由上赛季新西兰国家联赛冠军对阵查塔姆杯冠军。比赛于2024年3月3日在马丁·勒基公园举行。这是2021年国家联赛创办以来首次举办该赛事。作为主队，惠灵顿奥林匹克队选择新西兰心脏病儿童慈善组织作为受益方。

en.s: The 2024 Karabulak clash was a deadly stand-off between Russian security services and a cell of Ingush militants affiliated with Islamic State – Caucasus Province. The incident was the most significant clash in years regarding the Islamic insurgencies in the North Caucasus.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2024年卡拉布拉克冲突是俄罗斯安全部门与一支印古什武装人员小组之间的一场致命对峙。该武装小组隶属伊斯兰国高加索省。多年来，北高加索地区的伊斯兰叛乱活动中很少出现如此重大的冲突。
